name: Cornelia DeAyana
source:
Brigadier General / Field Commander
Nationality: UK

Firm and calculating. She is a brilliant tactician for her young age, which earned her the position of General. Her strict demeanor earned her the nickname "Ice Queen" among her colleagues. Considers herself a perfectionist.
